name: reinforced-computer-use
description: Windows-first bounded Computer Use with a Sky window2 adapter, local multi-stage workflows, optional Jev action selection, Codex visual grounding, and independent verification.

interface.shortDescription: Windows 优先的多步骤界面操作与长网页捕获
interface.longDescription: Codex 负责目标、权限、截图定位和最终验收；本插件通过现有 Computer Use 接口执行有限本地计划，保存多阶段接续进度，或让可选 Jev 从已允许的语义动作中选择下一步。缺少 AX 时由 Codex 根据新截图定位后单次执行，不赋予 Jev 视觉能力。范围变化、需检查的动作、输入不确定或验证失败时交还 Codex，接续不重放旧输入。
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Reinforced Computer Use to complete this Windows UI workflow with a bounded fast loop and independently verify the result.
